title: Binary Discrete Diffusion: Candidate-Set Diffusion for Logic and Planning Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2610.28543v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Discrete diffusion models iteratively denoise a noisy sequence of categorical data such as text, enabling any-order generation with self-correction and in-filling capabilities. This makes them promising candidates for reasoning, planning, and constrained-generation tasks like coding and math. Yet masked and uniform diffusion erase a token's identity in a single corruption event, so their noisy states cannot explicitly represent partially resolved uncertainty in which several alternatives remain plausible. We close this gap with Binary Discrete Diffusion, a family of continuous-time discrete-diffusion processes whose noisy state is a set of candidate tokens per position, represented as a binary membership vector. Binary diffusion changes candidate sets through additions and removals, allowing information to be lost and recovered gradually while the diffusion state itself represents partial uncertainty. translated_title: 二元离散扩散：面向逻辑与规划任务的候选集扩散
translated_abstract: 离散扩散模型通过迭代去噪由文本等分类数据构成的含噪序列，实现任意顺序的生成，并具备自校正与填充能力，这使其成为推理、规划以及代码、数学等受约束生成任务的有前景的候选方案。然而，掩码扩散和均匀扩散会在单次腐蚀事件中抹去词元的身份信息，因此其含噪状态无法显式表示那种多个备选词元仍然合理的部分解析不确定性。我们提出二元离散扩散来填补这一空白：这是一族连续时间离散扩散过程，其含噪状态是每个位置上的一组候选词元，以二进制隶属向量表示。二元扩散通过添加和删除操作来改变候选集，使信息能够逐渐丢失并逐渐恢复，同时扩散状态本身就表示部分不确定性。在Sudoku-Extreme、Boxoban和gr
tldr: 该论文提出二元离散扩散，将扩散过程的含噪状态表示为每个位置候选词元集合的二进制隶属向量，通过添加与删除候选实现信息的渐进丢失与恢复，从而能显式建模部分不确定性并有效解决数独、规划等逻辑与推理任务。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Binary Discrete Diffusion, a continuous-time discrete diffusion process whose noisy state is a per-position candidate token set represented as a binary membership vector, enabling gradual information loss and recovery while explicitly modeling partial uncertainty for logic and planning tasks such as Sudoku and box-push planning.
